question: Quina cartera de 3 o 6 actius conserva millor creixement compost net, supervivència i diversificació durant dotze mesos amb 500 USDC a Ostium?

universe.driver: tipus reals, crisi i flux oficial

risk.deleveraging: automatic because size is recalculated from current realized equity

cost_model.spread_slippage: measured bid/ask base plus 2x stress; never zero by default
cost_model.rollover: measured by side and holding interval, plus adverse stress
cost_model.failed_order_oracle_cost: included when represented in execution evidence

selection.primary: net compounded return subject to survival gates

discard_criteria: non-positive net expectancy under current base costs
required leverage above the preregistered portfolio cap
more than 50 percent of net profit from one asset
edge exists only with compounding or higher leverage
minimum size or free margin causes systematic skipped orders
sealed holdout was used before final selection
